deliverable.says: One deliverable is the accepted pull request for one issue. A new commit, or another pull request for the same issue, is a retry: the same deliverable, judged again and counted once. There is one for each issue.

evidence.says: Evidence counts only when signed by GitHub Actions for a run of drexthealpha/knos-workflows/.github/workflows/attest.yml; or by GitHub Actions for a run of drexthealpha/knos-workflows/.github/workflows/prove.yml.

checks.authority: the workflow files of acme/widgets at the commit the order was funded on
checks.says: A maintainer's merge decides, after `lint` (GitHub App 15368) and `unit` (GitHub App 15368) pass at the last commit. The authoritative copy: the workflow files of acme/widgets at the commit the order was funded on.

window.says: Payment is final when it is made: nothing is held back, and accepted work cannot be reopened.

changes.says: Only files matching `src/**`, `tests/**` may change. No change may touch `.github/**`, `.knos/**`. A contributor may add nothing outside that without the buyer's say.

dispute.says: The supplier may appeal a rejection within 7 days of it, with `/knos appeal <reason>`. There is no suite to run again. No arbiter is named, so a rejection stands unless both sides agree on one. Meanwhile the money stays in the order. With no verdict by the deadline, the money goes back to its funder.

evaluators.says: These may judge: `own` (GitHub Actions, workflow drexthealpha/knos-workflows/.github/workflows/prove.yml, in acme/widgets, owned by acme). One of them is enough.

price.says: Pays 50.00 test USDC, once, for an accepted deliverable. The funder pays the fee on top.

deadline.says: The order is open for 14 days from funding, or less if the funder cancels, which takes 7 days' notice. A token presented after that is refused, and the money goes back to its funder.

policy.says: @acme may publish a new version. A version never changes: a change is the next version, with its own hash, and an order keeps the version it was funded on.
